description: Reactive class fields (M6 stage B): a todo-list class in a .svelte.ts module with $state (deep: pushed plain objects become proxies), $state.raw (replaced whole), a #private $state field behind a getter, a field assigned $state in the constructor, a class instance in a $state field (not proxied), $derived and $derived.by fields read by the template, by other derived fields and by $effects (the 'done' effect re-runs only when its value changes), a class in the component script whose derived field reads component state, a module-level instance (a program global) read by the template, filters switched through a nested instance's field
